rows.text: The Wise Mothman spreads rad counters across every player at the table, turning each precombat main phase into a flurry of mill and life loss. The most common mistake is forgetting that Mothman's counter trigger fires whenever nonland cards are milled from ANY library, meaning you get triggers on opponents' upkeeps, combat steps, and your own turns alike. Distribute those counters to make Mothman an evasive lethal commander, go wide with mutant tokens, or assemble clean mill combos from turn 6 onward.

Bracket 3: Game Changers are capped at three (Cyclonic Rift, Demonic Tutor, Rhystic Study). No mass land denial. Two-card combos are included as decisive finishes but must not be fired before turn 6 under table expectations.
The engine runs on giving the entire table rad counters, causing each player to mill at their precombat main phase and lose life for nonland cards while feeding your counter triggers.

rows.name: The Wise Mothman
rows.text: enters and attacks giving each player a rad counter; distributes +1/+1 counters to up to X targets whenever X nonland cards are milled

rows.name: Mesmeric Orb
rows.text: forces every player to mill a card whenever their permanents untap; generates a constant stream of individual mill triggers across all turn cycles

rows.name: Ruin Crab
rows.text: mills each opponent for three whenever a land enters your battlefield; cracking a fetchland mills six cards per opponent

rows.name: Altar of the Brood
rows.text: triggers on every permanent entry including land drops and creature tokens, repeatedly milling each opponent

rows.name: Psychic Corrosion
rows.text: turns all of your card draw into repeatable milling across all three opponents

rows.name: Screeching Scorchbeast
rows.text: attacks to radiate the table for two counters each; creates 2/2 Zombie Mutant tokens whenever nonland cards are milled

rows.name: Mirelurk Queen
rows.text: gives target player two rad counters on entry; spawns 2/2 Mutant tokens whenever nonland cards are milled

rows.name: Tato Farmer
rows.text: gains you two rad counters on landfall and taps to ramp any land from any graveyard to the battlefield

rows.name: Glowing One
rows.text: attacks to grant four rad counters with deathtouch; gains you life equal to nonland cards milled anywhere

rows.name: Infesting Radroach
rows.text: an evasive flyer that adds rad counters on combat hit and recurs itself from your graveyard whenever nonland cards are milled

rows.name: Vexing Radgull
rows.text: early evasive flyer that seeds rad counters and gains counters whenever you proliferate

rows.name: Feral Ghoul
rows.text: grows when your creatures die and radiates each opponent for its entire counter count upon its own death

rows.name: Bloatfly Swarm
rows.text: enters with five counters, prevents combat damage by shedding counters, and radiates target player for each counter when it dies

rows.name: Mariposa Military Base
rows.text: utility land that seeds two rad counters on entry and converts spare late-game mana into extra card draw
Mothman's triggers spread counters broadly. These amplifiers multiply those counters into massive beatdown threats and card advantage.

rows.name: Branching Evolution
rows.text: doubles the number of +1/+1 counters placed on your creatures, accelerating Mothman into one-shot commander damage range

rows.name: Corpsejack Menace
rows.text: redundant counter doubling on a solid 4/4 body to rapidly overwhelm the table

rows.name: Hardened Scales
rows.text: adds an extra +1/+1 counter to each creature receiving counters, providing huge value for just one green mana

rows.name: Winding Constrictor
rows.text: adds an additional counter to permanents and players, accelerating rad counter stacks as well as creature power

rows.name: Kami of Whispered Hopes
rows.text: adds an additional counter whenever counters are placed and taps for mana equal to its power for massive explosive turns

rows.name: Evolution Sage
rows.text: proliferates on every land drop, increasing rad counters on opponents and +1/+1 counters across your board

rows.name: Evolution Witness
rows.text: adapts to trigger itself and recurs any permanent card from your graveyard to hand whenever counters are placed on it

rows.name: Danny Pink
rows.text: turns your distributed +1/+1 counters into card draw up to once per creature each turn

rows.name: Agent Frank Horrigan
rows.text: indestructible attacker that proliferates twice whenever it enters or attacks

rows.name: Radstorm
rows.text: storm instant that proliferates multiple times at instant speed to blow out the table with rads and counters

rows.name: Inexorable Tide
rows.text: proliferates whenever you cast any spell, steadily cascading counters out of control

rows.name: Rhystic Study
rows.text: premier card engine that taxes opposing spells and keeps your hand full of interaction

rows.name: Mystic Remora
rows.text: early tax engine that punishes artifact ramp and spell-heavy openers

rows.name: Struggle for Project Purity
rows.text: Brotherhood draws three cards each upkeep; Enclave punishes anyone attacking you with double rad counters

rows.name: The Master, Transcendent
rows.text: enters radiating a player and taps to steal any creature milled from any library that turn as a 3/3 mutant

rows.name: Muldrotha, the Gravetide
rows.text: casts permanents straight from your milled graveyard each turn, turning self-mill into pure card advantage

rows.name: Reanimate
rows.text: reanimates the best creature milled from any player's graveyard for a single black mana

rows.name: Deathrite Shaman
rows.text: utilizes spent cards in graveyards for mana acceleration, incidental life gain, and direct drain
Under Bracket 3 table expectations, do not fire these combos before turn 6. Use them to cleanly finish long games once the table has developed.

rows.name: Duskmantle Guildmage + Mindcrank
rows.text: activate Guildmage's first ability for {1}{U}{B}; any card entering an opponent's graveyard deals 1 damage, Mindcrank mills a card, looping infinitely until life totals hit zero

rows.name: Bloodchief Ascension + Mindcrank
rows.text: with three quest counters on Ascension, any card entering an opponent's graveyard drains 2 life, Mindcrank mills two cards, creating an infinite lethal drain loop

rows.name: Bruvac the Grandiloquent + Maddening Cacophony
rows.text: kicking Cacophony for {4}{U}{U} forces opponents to mill half their libraries; Bruvac doubles the mill to their entire library, decking all opponents simultaneously

rows.name: Syr Konrad, the Grim + Mindcrank
rows.text: creature cards milled or dying deal 1 damage to each opponent, which triggers Mindcrank to mill more cards, generating a self-perpetuating mill chain

rows.name: Demonic Tutor -> Mindcrank
rows.text: fetches the missing artifact piece for either Duskmantle Guildmage or Bloodchief Ascension to close the game

rows.name: Demonic Tutor -> Maddening Cacophony
rows.text: finds the sorcery half of the Bruvac library wipe once six mana is available

rows.name: Demonic Tutor -> Cyclonic Rift
rows.text: tutors your one-sided board wipe to clear opposing blockers and swing for lethal commander damage

rows.name: Cyclonic Rift
rows.text: asymmetric board wipe that overloads for {6}{U} to bounce all opposing permanents, opening up an immediate lethal attack

rows.name: Toxic Deluge
rows.text: efficient board wipe that clears indestructible boards and resets runaway threats for minimal mana

rows.name: Nuclear Fallout
rows.text: scales -X/-X based on mana invested while blanketing the entire table with rad counters to fuel Mothman

rows.name: Deadly Rollick
rows.text: free creature exile while your commander is on the battlefield to answer must-kill threats

rows.name: Assassin's Trophy
rows.text: universal permanent removal that cleanly answers problematic lands, enchantments, or artifacts

rows.name: Atomize
rows.text: destroys any nonland permanent and immediately proliferates rad and creature counters

rows.name: Mana Drain
rows.text: hard counter that converts countered opposing spells into colorless mana for your next main phase

rows.name: Counterspell
rows.text: clean two-mana answer to opposing sweepers or game-winning plays

rows.name: Swan Song
rows.text: one-mana defense against game-ending sorceries, instants, or enchantments

rows.name: Stubborn Denial
rows.text: active ferocious turns this into a one-mana hard counter for noncreature spells once Mothman or another mutant hits four power

rows.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
rows.text: reliable one-mana counter against noncreature spells

rows.name: Heroic Intervention
rows.text: grants your board hexproof and indestructible at instant speed against sweepers and removal

rows.name: Mutational Advantage
rows.text: grants permanents with counters hexproof and indestructible, prevents damage, and proliferates

rows.name: Ripples of Potential
rows.text: proliferates and phases out your permanents with counters to protect them through exile sweepers like Farewell

rows.name: Swiftfoot Boots
rows.text: gives your commander hexproof and haste to attack and distribute rad counters immediately

Prioritize hands with two to three lands, early ramp (Sol Ring, a signet, Birds of Paradise, or Delighted Halfling), and an early mill or counter engine like Ruin Crab, Hardened Scales, or Mesmeric Orb.

Cast The Wise Mothman on turn 3 or 4 to begin radiating the table. Put the first few +1/+1 counters onto Mothman to quickly reach lethal commander damage while protecting him with Stubborn Denial, Ripples of Potential, or Mutational Advantage.
If opponents deploy heavy creature boards, rely on Glowing One and Nuclear Fallout to stabilize while ticking up rad counters.
Once turn 6 arrives, tutor for or deploy Mindcrank alongside Duskmantle Guildmage or Bloodchief Ascension, or kick Maddening Cacophony with Bruvac, to close out the game cleanly.
